name: 最多交换 K 次的最大固定长度子数组的最大和
englishName: Maximum Subarray Sum of Fixed Length After at Most K Swaps
hints: 1a (Greedy Exchanges): Fix the position of the final subarray. Swapping two elements that are both inside it or both outside it does not change its sum.

1b (Greedy Exchanges): Sort the inside elements increasingly and the outside elements decreasingly. Pair the smallest inside elements with the largest outside elements, using at most min(k, length, nums.length - length) swaps and stopping when the gain is non-positive.
1c (Greedy Exchanges): Evaluate every subarray of the required length and take the largest resulting sum.

2a (Sliding Window and Order Statistics): Let b = min(k, length, nums.length - length). Mark the indices of any length largest elements in the whole array. Their sum is an upper bound, attained whenever a window contains at least length - b marked indices.

2b (Sliding Window and Order Statistics): Otherwise, an optimum for that window can use exactly b outside elements. Its value is the sum of the largest length - b inside elements and the largest b outside elements.

2c (Sliding Window and Order Statistics): Maintain the inside and outside value counts and sums as the window slides. Coordinate compression and Fenwick trees support the required largest-element sum queries in logarithmic time.
